## Before submitting

- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

Tests (test tiers)

## Summary

`tiers/smoke_cc100.txt` and `tiers/smoke_cc100_code_paths.tsv` now list `sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_pointer_abi.py::test_direct_d256_decode_launch_follows_the_token_unit_contract`. They previously listed `test_direct_d256_decode_launch_rejects_rows_outside_tile`.

## Why

- #1543 (46786f137) renamed that test but left the old id in the two tier files.
- So `test_tiers.py::test_every_listed_cell_collects[smoke_cc100.txt]` fails on every python lane, dev and rel, sm80/sm90/sm100.
- Seen in pipeline 72832453 (#1548); it applies to every PR based on develop after 46786f137.
- #1543's last pipeline ran only the frost and cutedsl targets, so `python_tests` did not catch it there.

## Testing

On B200 with cuDNN 9.27:

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `pytest -o addopts= test_tiers.py` | 11 passed |
| `pytest -o addopts= -m smoke sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_pointer_abi.py` (includes the renamed cell) | 2 passed |
